newsitem.title: USA: Sky Games says weighs financial options.
newsitem.headline: Sky Games says weighs financial options.

text.p: Sky Games International Ltd said on Tuesday that it asked Montgomery Securities to help it weigh future financial options, including raising additional capital.
Sky Games develops and supports gaming software for interactive in-flight entertainment systems.

"Montgomery Securities will evaluate the company's financial options, including the raising of additional capital and assist the company in achieving its goals," Laurence Geller, chairman, said in a statement.
